a:

yes, it is a color. it is a color in the sense that it can be described as blue, green, orange, red, violet, etc. but it is not a color in the sense that it can be described as "white". if you use it as a word, then that would be wrong.

a:

white is a color because it refers to the hue of blue. but it is not a color in the sense that it can be described as "white".

the word "white" is a color adjective that describes a color.
